text: {"lessons":["Selling after a quick gain can reduce my participation in further upside, so I should base sales on my goals and the investment outlook rather than gains versus average cost alone.","Trading infrequently kept me from reacting to small monthly changes, but I should still review my holdings and cash allocation deliberately over time.","My account rose overall despite a brief decline; I should judge decisions over a longer horizon and avoid treating short-term account movements as proof that a strategy is working or failing."]}
